info.name: SnackRapido - Orders Service
info.description: GraphQL API for the Orders Service (port 4002). Requires api-users and api-restaurants running. All mutations/queries require a valid access token.

graphql.query:
mutation CreateOrder($createOrderDto: CreateOrderDto!) {
  createOrder(createOrderDto: $createOrderDto) {
    message
    error { message code }
    order {
      id
      orderNumber
      status
      paymentStatus
      deliveryType
      subtotal
      tax
      deliveryFee
      discount
      total
      customerName
      customerEmail
      restaurantName
      deliveryAddress
      estimatedDeliveryTime
      createdAt
      items {
        id
        menuItemName
        quantity
        unitPrice
        totalPrice
      }
    }
  }
}

query GetOrderById($orderId: String!) {
  getOrderById(orderId: $orderId) {
    id
    orderNumber
    status
    paymentStatus
    deliveryType
    subtotal
    tax
    deliveryFee
    discount
    total
    customerName
    customerEmail
    customerPhone
    restaurantName
    restaurantAddress
    deliveryAddress
    deliveryInstructions
    specialInstructions
    estimatedDeliveryTime
    deliveredAt
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    items {
      id
      menuItemName
      menuItemDescription
      quantity
      unitPrice
      totalPrice
      specialRequests
    }
    statusHistory {
      id
      status
      previousStatus
      reason
      changedBy
      changedByRole
      timestamp
    }
  }
}

item.name: Order Status Flow
item.description: Status transitions: PENDING → CONFIRMED → PREPARING → READY → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → DELIVERED

item.name: Create Order Review
item.description: Order must be in DELIVERED status first
